verdict.rationale: Convex's own CLI watches the local filesystem and pushes schema changes to the dev deployment when the schema file changes (convex-docs-6, convex-docs-17), and schemas are optional (convex-docs-3). That amounts to schema-as-code applied via the CLI, but only for dev; nothing in the pack shows migration files or a CI/production apply path. missing for 10: explicit migration files or tooling, data-migration workflow for existing documents, production/CI deploy command for schema changes, rollback or versioning semantics, independent corroboration.
